function.name: webfetch
function.description: Fetch a whole official documentation page from the task-scoped HTTPS allowlist. Follows only allowed public first-party redirects. Returns status, final URL and generic full-page text with links/anchors. Failures are not page content. Maximum 32 attempts; 2 MiB raw body and 256 KiB model text per fetch; truncation is explicit.
